adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6#save`, the client always sets `host.category` from the local `categoryId` (`Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))`) after `host.save(props)`. But the server (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) explicitly overrides a blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. For a new host where `categoryId` is `null` (default) and the user doesn't choose a category (`category-chooser value=categoryId`), the request sends `category_id = null`, the response will contain a non-null `category_id`, yet the UI forces `host.category` to `undefined` via `findById(null)`. The template renders `{{category-badge host.category}}`, so it can show blank/wrong until reload despite the record having the correct server `category_id`.
